import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

if command[:1] == ['--']:
    command = command[1:]
if not command or any(c not in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_' for c in label):
    raise SystemExit('Use a simple label followed by the command arguments.')
out = Path(__file__).parent
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
start = time.monotonic()
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
diff = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--binary', 'HEAD'])
with (out / (label + '.log')).open('wb') as log:
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record = {
    'command': command,
    'cwd': os.getcwd(),
    'source_head': head,
    'uncommitted_diff_sha256': hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest(),
    'started_at': started,
    'completed_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'duration_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - start, 3),

    'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256((out / (label + '.log')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
}
(out / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode if result.returncode >= 0 else 128 - result.returncode)
